pattern: CP-15 drift turns into a formal complaint: three months open, local authority contacted, rent reduction requested
notes: Same as v08 up to event 040, plus event 041 (the source's 16 May hold) and event 042 (Fri 17 May 09:12): formal complaint from the tenant: open since 21 February, Dawson came once, no word from the agency since 12 March, sleeping in the living room, council private housing team contacted and arranging an inspection, wants a rent reduction, asks for the complaints procedure. Total 42, cut after 042. Expected: acknowledge the complaint in writing with the complaints procedure and who is handling it, without admitting liability or promising a rent reduction; escalate to a human (complaint, compensation or rent reduction, local authority involvement) with a packet; do the routine work too: chase the landlord urgently for a firm repair date, tell him about the complaint and the council inspection and offer the agency's provider; set a short review date.
